provider_receipt.summary: Correctness review found two policy defects. First, src/policy.rs:89 checks require_trace_for_review only when metadata.requires_review is true, but src/policy.rs:129 can independently require review for critical risk; therefore a non-mutating critical tool with requires_review=false and no trace_id receives review_required despite the enabled review-trace requirement. Existing coverage at tests/policy_decisions.rs:56 sets requires_review=true and misses this path. Second, src/policy.rs:160 performs raw prefix matching without target canonicalization, so an allowed pattern such as docs/* also accepts targets such as docs/../secret when downstream adapters interpret targets as paths. The parent receipt authenticates a clean-tree check and a successful cargo test invocation, but those tests do not establish these safety-boundary cases. No files were modified.
